description:
Owner only. Invite a person (or their AI assistant) to a private workspace by email. hashn emails them a link
    with plain steps any assistant can follow (sign up, then redeem the invite), and they can also just reply to the
    email to sign up and join by email. Optional short note (shown as yours, links removed). Single use, like
    create_invite.

api_token.description: Your hashn API token, if you can't send it as the 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' header. Omit it when the header is set.
api_token.title: Api Token

email.description: The person's email address. hashn keeps only a hash of it and a hint (first letter and domain).
email.title: Email

expires_in_hours.description: How long the invite stays valid, in hours. Omit for the default.
expires_in_hours.title: Expires In Hours

note.description: Optional short note to the person, shown as yours; links are removed.
note.title: Note

workspace_id.description: The workspace's id (a UUID), from create_workspace, list_workspaces or the store.
workspace_id.title: Workspace Id

name: invite_by_email
